newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CSR sells U.S. aggregates business.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CSR sells U.S. aggregates business.

text.p: CSR Ltd said on Friday it has sold its American Aggregates quarrying business in Indiana and Ohio, and expects to sell the remaining Michigan business within a few days.
CSR said the total purchase price of the two sales would be about A$345 million.
A write down of about A$4 million would be required against this year's profit, the company said.
CSR managing director Geoff Kells said the sale was part of a drive to boost profits and increase shareholder value by divesting under-performing or non-strategic assets.
"The sale will increase returns on the remaining funds in CSR America by between 1.5 percent and 2.0 percent," Kells said in a statement.
The sale of the Indiana and Ohio operations, the major part of the business, to Martin Marietta Materials Inc was foreshadowed earlier this year.
The U.S. Justice Department on Tuesday gave permission for the acquisition on the basis that the U.S. group sold an American Aggregates quarry in Indianapolis, Indiana.
A CSR spokesman said the A$345 million purchase price included the Indiana and Ohio sales, as well as the expected Michigan sale.
CSR said in January the Indiana and Ohio businesses would sell for about US$235 million, or about A$305 million.
The spokesman declined to identify the likely purchaser of the Michigan business.
